stem: All containers receive the same programmed irrigation volume, but moisture readings show one bench is consistently drier than the others. What is the best next investigation?
choices: Raise fertilizer EC on the dry bench because lower moisture usually means that bench is consuming nutrients faster
Move the cultivar from the dry bench because repeated moisture differences are primarily caused by genotype-specific water use rather than delivery or media variation
Lower room temperature for the dry bench until its sensor readings match the wetter benches at the same time
Check emitter delivery, placement, drainage, and media distribution before assuming equal programmed volume gave equal root-zone moisture
rationale: Equal programmed volume does not guarantee equal delivery or retention. Irrigation uniformity, emitter placement, drainage and media properties should be checked against measured root-zone response.
